claims.quote: Mechanistically, miR-132-3p targeted heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein U (HNRNPU).

claims.object_text: RNA binding protein that regulates mRNA stability of BACE1
claims.quote: HNRNPU acted as an RNA binding protein (RBP) to regulate the mRNA stability of β-site amyloid precursor protein cleaving enzyme 1 (BACE1).

claims.object_text: reversed the effects of miR-132-3p overexpression on the viability and apoptosis of Aβ1-42-treated SH-SY5Y cells
claims.quote: Overexpression of HNRNPU or BACE1 reversed the effects of miR-132-3p overexpression on the viability and apoptosis of Aβ1-42-treated SH-SY5Y cells.

claims.object_text: alleviates impairments of learning and memory abilities in AD rats
claims.quote: In conclusion, miR-132-3p reduces apoptosis of SH-SY5Y cells and alleviates impairments of learning and memory abilities in AD rats by modulating the HNRNPU/BACE1 axis.
